_note: Where each fixture comes from. 'recorded' = a real Google response recorded by an open-source project's test suite (VCR cassette or fixture-recording script). Recorded pytrends cassettes are from March-April 2023 (keywords pizza/bagel, hl=en-US, tz=360).

explore-pizza-bagel-2021.txt: recorded: pytrends test_tokens.yaml (explore for 2021-01-01 2021-12-31, 2 terms: TIMESERIES, GEO_MAP, GEO_MAP_0/1, RELATED_QUERIES_0/1, no RELATED_TOPICS)

relatedsearches-queries-pizza.txt: recorded: pytrends test_related_queries_result_top.yaml (/widgetdata/relatedsearches, top 25 + rising 11 incl. Breakout)
comparedgeo-compared-countries.txt: recorded: pytrends test_interest_by_region_ok.yaml (/widgetdata/comparedgeo for the multi-term GEO_MAP, 250 countries, 2 values each)
